title: Interest Survey Results
description: 47 survey responses grouped by age range and interest level -- enough to decide whether a club is worth starting, and for whom.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Gauging Interest and Holding Your First Meeting

educational.audience: Prospective club founders reading survey results

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a set of grouped survey results, the learner interprets whether there is enough concentrated interest, in which age range, to justify starting a club.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover a segment for exact counts; click a legend entry to toggle a series across all bars
pedagogical.assessment: Ask which age range the club should target and what in the chart supports it.
